items.title: c) Identification of Calcium (Ca²⁺) radical (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: c) Identification of Calcium (Ca²⁺) radical: a main subheading of 16.7 Tests for identification of basic radicals, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 345-346.

blocks.text: Saaf test tube mein 4 g solid sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Calcium radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Safed precipitate banta hai jo zyada (excess) NaOH mein nahi ghulta.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Sirf halki turbidity (dhundlapan) aata hai ya koi precipitate nahi banta.
